title.zh: 10 天实战 NVIDIA Dynamo

subtitle.zh: 从推理 worker 到可测量的服务系统
subtitle.en: From inference workers to a measurable serving system

description.zh: 10天逐步拆解NVIDIA Dynamo：每天有原理图、可运行CPU实验、对照结果、排错和测验。用带原始记录的工程作品连接学习与求职；真实引擎扩展和教学模拟分别说明。
description.en: Ten guided days for NVIDIA Dynamo: diagrams, runnable CPU models, controls, troubleshooting and quizzes, culminating in an evidence-backed portfolio. Real-engine extensions are clearly separate from simulations.

hoursPerDay.zh: 每天 2–3 小时；GPU、容器与 Kubernetes 环境准备另计
hoursPerDay.en: 2–3 hours a day; GPU, container, and Kubernetes setup are extra

prerequisites.zh: 熟悉一个推理引擎、Python/HTTP、容器和性能指标；第 8 天需了解 Kubernetes Pod、Service 和资源请求。先完成 vLLM 或 SGLang 更容易。
prerequisites.en: Know one inference engine, Python/HTTP, containers, and performance metrics. Day 8 uses Kubernetes Pods, Services, and resource requests. Complete vLLM or SGLang first.

hardware.zh: CPU教学实验：Python3.9+标准库和普通电脑。真实框架/模型/GPU扩展见实验包README的版本、环境和步骤；当前发布未做GPU实测。
hardware.en: CPU exercises: Python3.9+ standard library and a laptop. See lab README for versions, environments and steps for real-framework/GPU extensions; this publication did not run GPU benchmarks.

zh: 推理平台工程师
AI Infra SRE
分布式系统工程师
en: Inference platform engineer
AI infrastructure SRE
Distributed systems engineer

outcome.zh: 一个包含逐日原始JSON、对照CSV、独立函数挑战、文件哈希与个人分析报告的工程作品；清楚区分模拟和真实框架记录。
outcome.en: A portfolio containing daily raw JSON, comparison CSV, an independent function challenge, file hashes and your analysis, separating simulation from actual framework records.

title.zh: 建立服务系统的三张图

lesson.zh: Dynamo把前端、路由、worker、服务发现、规划与数据移动组合成服务系统。逻辑职责分开后，才能解释“worker在列表里却不能接请求”或“路由成功但KV传输失败”。
lesson.en: Dynamo combines frontend, routing, workers, discovery, planning and data movement. Separating responsibilities explains a listed but unready worker or a successful route followed by failed KV transfer.

task.zh: 为一个请求画三种颜色的箭头，标出健康状态更新与KV数据流的区别。
task.en: Draw three colors of arrows for a request, distinguishing health updates from KV data flow.

evidence.en: Baseline and changed day01.json records, your code diff and an explanation of the comparison.

title.zh: 控制面、请求面与数据面

body.zh: Dynamo把前端、路由、worker、服务发现、规划与数据移动组合成服务系统。逻辑职责分开后，才能解释“worker在列表里却不能接请求”或“路由成功但KV传输失败”。
body.en: Dynamo combines frontend, routing, workers, discovery, planning and data movement. Separating responsibilities explains a listed but unready worker or a successful route followed by failed KV transfer.

body.zh: 基线输出请求面3项、控制面3项、数据面3项。changed场景是worker崩溃后成员状态更新。三个平面不是三台固定机器，部署时可共享进程或节点。
body.en: The baseline lists three components per plane; the changed scenario updates membership after a worker crash. Planes are logical responsibilities, not three fixed machines.

question.zh: 服务发现主要属于？
question.en: Which plane owns service discovery?

explanation.zh: 服务发现维护参与者状态，供请求路由使用。
explanation.en: Discovery tracks participants for request routing.

explanation.zh: 职责划分与进程/节点放置是不同设计维度。

title.zh: 模拟服务发现与就绪筛选

lesson.zh: worker启动后可能先注册，再下载模型、分配内存和预热。路由应只选择ready集合。这个简单状态表帮助理解为什么扩容请求发出后容量不会立即增加。
lesson.en: A worker may register before loading weights, allocating memory and warming up. Route only to ready workers. This state table explains why requested scale-out does not immediately add capacity.

explanation.zh: 注册和就绪是两个不同状态。

question.zh: 扩容命令成功意味着？
question.en: What does a successful scale command imply?

explanation.zh: 创建进程、拉镜像和加载权重都可能延迟实际容量。
explanation.en: Process creation, image pulls and weight loading can delay usable capacity.

title.zh: 用 SLO 定义实验目标

lesson.zh: 只看成功率会忽略太慢的成功请求。这里的goodput_fraction定义为同时成功且延迟不超过阈值的请求数/全部请求数，是达标比例，不是每秒请求数。
lesson.en: Success rate ignores successful but late requests. goodput_fraction here is successful requests within the latency threshold divided by all requests. It is an attainment fraction, not requests per second.

title.zh: SLO达标率保留全部分母
title.en: Keep the full denominator for SLO attainment

body.zh: 只看成功率会忽略太慢的成功请求。这里的goodput_fraction定义为同时成功且延迟不超过阈值的请求数/全部请求数，是达标比例，不是每秒请求数。
body.en: Success rate ignores successful but late requests. goodput_fraction here is successful requests within the latency threshold divided by all requests. It is an attainment fraction, not requests per second.

title.zh: 手算与反例

body.zh: 四条请求中3成功，成功率0.75；100ms阈值只有40和80达标，所以比例0.5。阈值改60ms，只40达标，比例0.25。错误即使10ms返回也不达标。
body.en: Three of four requests succeed, yielding0.75. At100ms only40 and80 meet the target, giving0.5. At60ms only40 meets it, giving0.25. A10ms error never qualifies.

title.zh: 动手调参：连接图解与实验
title.en: Change parameters: connect widget and lab

body.zh: 拖动排队时间观察单请求何时超过你的SLO，再回到四条原始请求分别打标。交互条是单请求时间分解；达标率的分母仍是全部4条，不能因为一条失败就只除以3。
body.en: Vary queue time until a request exceeds your SLO, then label each of the four raw rows. The widget decomposes one request; SLO attainment still divides by all four submitted requests, including the failure.

question.zh: 10ms的错误响应算达标吗？

explanation.zh: 定义要求成功和及时同时满足。
explanation.en: The definition requires both success and timeliness.

title.zh: 比较缓存亲和与负载均衡

lesson.zh: 偏向有缓存的worker可以减少prefill，但它可能已有长队。本模型用排队时间+max(0,40−缓存节省)作为完成时间估计，选择最小值；真实路由器还需处理状态过期和批处理。
lesson.en: A cached worker can save prefill but have a longer queue. The model minimizes queue+max(0,40−cache savings). A real router must also handle stale state and batching.

task.zh: 让缓存节省为0和40分别验证边界，解释为什么不能只按命中率路由。
task.en: Test savings0 and40 and explain why hit rate alone is insufficient for routing.

title.zh: 缓存亲和需要和排队一起比较

body.zh: 偏向有缓存的worker可以减少prefill，但它可能已有长队。本模型用排队时间+max(0,40−缓存节省)作为完成时间估计，选择最小值；真实路由器还需处理状态过期和批处理。
body.en: A cached worker can save prefill but have a longer queue. The model minimizes queue+max(0,40−cache savings). A real router must also handle stale state and batching.

title.zh: 手算与反例

body.zh: 基线a排队10、节省35，估计15ms；b排队0、节省0，估计40ms，选a。changed把a排队改100，估计105ms，改选b。
body.en: Baseline a has queue10/savings35, giving15ms; b gives40ms, so select a. With a’s queue100, its105ms estimate loses to b.

title.zh: 动手调参：连接图解与实验
title.en: Change parameters: connect widget and lab

body.zh: 交互图体现前缀复用可以减少的计算；本日路由脚本再把排队时间加上。比较亲和worker的15ms和忙时105ms：即使命中相同，路由选择也会反转，说明命中率不是唯一目标。
body.en: The widget shows compute saved by prefix reuse; the routing script adds queue time. The affinity worker costs15ms or105ms when busy. Identical cache affinity can lead to opposite route choices, so hit rate is not the only objective.

question.zh: 缓存worker排队100ms时仍应强制选它吗？

title.zh: 判断 P/D 分离是否值得

lesson.zh: Prefill、传输、Decode各有服务能力。理想流水线上限取阶段容量的最小值；单请求延迟却是阶段时长之和。该模型固定1P+1D，不包含批处理、网络竞争和额外系统开销。
lesson.en: Prefill, transfer and decode each impose capacity. Ideal pipeline capacity is their minimum; single-request latency is their sum. This model fixes1P+1D and omits batching, contention and overhead.

task.zh: 增加一个P worker与一个D worker分别预测上限，保留相同传输瓶颈。
task.en: Add one P worker and one D worker in separate predictions while retaining the transfer bottleneck.

body.zh: 填写REPORT.md的所有TODO，写明问题、本人改动、输入、对照、一个不改善的条件和下一次实验。check.py默认检查student.py；--reference只验证随包参考实现，不能据此声称自己的挑战已完成。
body.en: Fill every REPORT.md TODO: question, own change, inputs, controls, a no-benefit condition and the next experiment. check.py checks student.py by default; --reference checks the supplied solution and does not demonstrate your implementation.

title.zh: 独立函数的输入输出

body.zh: 独立实现就绪worker代价选择与SLO达标率。先过滤ready，再最小化queue_ms+max(0,40-saved_prefill_ms)，平局选输入顺序靠前者，无就绪者返回None。达标率将失败计入分母；空负载返回None，不能宣称100%达标。
body.en: Implement readiness-filtered worker selection and SLO attainment. Filter ready workers, minimize queue_ms+max(0,40-saved_prefill_ms), break ties by input order and returnNone if none are ready. Failures remain in the attainment denominator. Empty workload returnsNone, not100%success.

title.zh: 从实验到作品

caption.zh: 作品可以是清楚标注的模拟分析；没有真机实验就不写真实引擎性能结论。
caption.en: A portfolio may contain clearly labeled simulation analysis; do not claim real-engine performance without measurements.

title.zh: 在两个目录复现全部实验
title.en: Reproduce all experiments in separate directories

body.zh: 以下脚本只运行CPU教学模型，不连接真实服务；检查每份文件的evidence字段。
body.en: These scripts run CPU models only and connect to no real service. Inspect evidence labels.

walkthrough.command:
python3 lab.py day10 --out out/final-base
python3 lab.py day10 --variant changed --out out/final-changed

expected.en: Each directory contains nine daily JSON files, results.csv, manifest.json and REPORT.md.

title.zh: 完成独立挑战与报告

body.zh: 编辑student.py中的TODO，再运行检查。第一次未完成时显示NOT YET是预期结果；可以看提示，最后再核对参考解。
body.en: Edit student.py TODOs before checking. An initial NOT YET is expected. Use the hints and compare the reference only after attempting your own solution.

expected.zh: 完成后student检查显示PASS；报告的TODO由你填写，selfcheck通过不代表报告已完成。
expected.en: Your completed student check shows PASS. Fill report TODOs yourself; selfcheck does not complete the report.

fix.zh: 先实现student.py，不要把--reference通过误当自己的通过；参考边界案例定位。
fix.en: Implement student.py; passing --reference is not passing your own work. Use the boundary cases to debug.

symptom.zh: 报告只有数字没有解释

fix.zh: 补充假设、改动、反例与未验证项；请同伴从命令重算一项结论。
fix.en: Add assumptions, changes, counterexamples and unverified claims; ask a peer to recompute one conclusion.

question.zh: 确定性模拟重复三次能证明GPU加速吗？
question.en: Do three deterministic replays prove GPU acceleration?

explanation.zh: 硬件结论需要真实运行、环境、负载与波动记录。
explanation.en: Hardware conclusions require measurements, environment, workload and variation.

question.zh: 以下哪项最能体现个人贡献？
question.en: Which best expresses personal contribution?

options.zh: 展示自己的修改、证据和局限
options.en: Showing your changes, evidence and limitations

explanation.zh: 可解释的改动和证据让别人能审阅你的判断。
explanation.en: Explainable changes and evidence let others review your judgement.
